name: 01_T_initial
caption: Reactive kernel at 40 μs. Same 32×8 grid and camera; ownership is assembled using migrated canonical cell IDs. Cell clocks are measured wall times, not reaction rates.

name: 02_chemCost_initial
caption: Measured chemistry cost at 40 μs. Same 32×8 grid and camera; ownership is assembled using migrated canonical cell IDs. Cell clocks are measured wall times, not reaction rates.

name: 03_owner_initial
caption: Initial Scotch ownership. Same 32×8 grid and camera; ownership is assembled using migrated canonical cell IDs. Cell clocks are measured wall times, not reaction rates.

name: 04_owner_weighted
caption: Cost-weighted Scotch ownership. Same 32×8 grid and camera; ownership is assembled using migrated canonical cell IDs. Cell clocks are measured wall times, not reaction rates.

name: 05_processor_interfaces
caption: Cyan lines mark internal ownership changes. Cyclic boundary interfaces also count in quantitative face totals but lie at box boundaries.

name: 06_moving_sequence
caption: Moving-condition temperature sequence with an identical camera and shared data-range color scale. These coarse controlled kernels are not validated flame fronts.

name: 07_workload_by_rank
caption: Checkpoint cell-clock sums assigned to old and new owners. This diagnostic does not assume that future cell costs stay fixed.

name: 08_chemistry_by_rank
caption: Rank-local integrated phase durations from repeat zero, persistent checkpoint 40 μs. Phases overlap across ranks and their maxima must not be added to infer a critical path.

name: 09_timestep_by_rank
caption: Rank-local integrated phase durations from repeat zero, persistent checkpoint 40 μs. Phases overlap across ranks and their maxima must not be added to infer a critical path.

name: 10_all_action_costs
caption: Complete oracle state set, five randomized trials per action. Total cost includes action configuration, native mesh redistribution and solver process startup plus endpoint I/O.

name: 11_strong_scaling
caption: Five trials per configuration on one six-core WSL2 host. Per-case decomposition is recorded separately. This is a small-domain, single-node experiment, not network scaling.

name: 12_parallel_efficiency
caption: Five trials per configuration on one six-core WSL2 host. Per-case decomposition is recorded separately. This is a small-domain, single-node experiment, not network scaling.

name: 13_speedup_intervals
caption: Pointwise 95% bootstrap intervals for independent median ratios (4000 resamples), five trials each. Multiple state selection is exploratory; intervals are not simultaneous or confirmatory.

name: 14_faces_vs_weight
caption: Native redistributed mesh face counts, including cyclic processor interfaces. Weight clipping is fixed at [0.1,10]; stronger weighting need not change an integer partition monotonically.

name: 15_mpi_call_time
caption: PMPI calls on the persistent condition. These durations include imbalance-induced waits; they are not pure network transfer times. No extra barriers or collectives are added by the profiler.

name: 16_persistence_correlation
caption: Actual future costs are used only for this diagnostic. Controller inputs use previous and current costs. Timing noise and reaction evolution both affect correlations.

name: 17_prediction_accuracy
caption: Coefficients fit on five entire training conditions; two whole validation conditions set conservative residual margins; three held-out conditions are untouched by fitting. Setup costs are excluded from this solver-delta plot.

name: 18_confusion_matrix
caption: Median oracle labels can change within runtime noise. This matrix covers six held-out checkpoint states, not independent flow trajectories.

name: 19_controller_regret
caption: Retrospective regret includes measured feature extraction for feature-driven policies. This is distinct from independent deployment and live end-to-end timings.

name: 20_cumulative_runtime
caption: Repeat-zero measured rollout. All policies reach 280 μs. Dashed AM fails the predefined endpoint field gate and is descriptive timing evidence only. Uninterrupted arms provide an endpoint only; no interpolated cumulative clock is invented. No trial is removed.

name: 21_rebalancing_events
caption: Three actual rollouts per condition; features come only from the completed prefix of that same rollout. The frozen model has a forty-step cooldown.

name: 22_predicted_benefit
caption: Benefits are solver deltas before action setup and residual safety margins. Prediction error is reported even when the controller declines to act.

name: 23_oracle_controller_comparison
caption: Aggregate ratios sum checkpoint median costs. Conditional 95% intervals resample runs within the same fixed test states, retaining frozen choices and observed oracle labels. They exclude model-fitting and case-population uncertainty. The hindsight oracle remains optimistic and is not executable online.

name: 24_ablations
caption: Features are omitted according to documented variants. The initial communication feature is constant across same-grid states, so noCommunication cannot establish communication-model usefulness. EMA denotes a two-snapshot blend.

name: 25_regime_map
caption: Marker size reflects the bounded past-cost lifetime estimate. Black outlines flag A0 or winner intervals crossing unity. No fitted boundary or unobserved winning region is imposed.

name: 26_mass_conservation
caption: Native thermodynamic inventory uses stored h and rho when available. Total energy is ∑ρV(h+hc+|U|²/2)−∑pV. Agreement between actions does not establish physical conservation or mesh/timestep convergence.

name: 27_energy_conservation
caption: Native thermodynamic inventory uses stored h and rho when available. Total energy is ∑ρV(h+hc+|U|²/2)−∑pV. Agreement between actions does not establish physical conservation or mesh/timestep convergence.

name: 28_timestep_refinement
caption: Each grid uses its own 0.5 μs reference, which is not an exact solution. Spatial refinement and heat-release changes remain limitations for physical flame interpretation.

name: 29_fine_timestep_actions
caption: Five trials per action. Eight times more physical steps over the same continuation duration; still the original coarse grid and hence not a validated resolved-flame benchmark.

name: 30_migration_horizon
caption: Net measured benefit includes the native redistribution process. No extrapolated crossing is called observed. Future work may change the compute and communication penalties.

name: 31_chemistry_fraction
caption: Rank means over the last five physical steps. Synchronized nonchemistry phases can contain chemistry imbalance waits; this ratio is explanatory, not an Amdahl bound.

name: 32_linear_iterations
caption: Iteration counts parsed from native solver logs. Counts alone do not identify cache misses or pure halo-communication cost.

name: 33_architecture
caption: Architecture: chemistry tasks are offloaded inside the compatible Stuttgart library; mesh migration is native redistributePar between solver processes.

name: 34_methodology
caption: Methodology preserves held-out conditions and distinguishes retrospective oracle labels from executed controller decisions.

name: 35_quicklb_reproduction
caption: Public version 0.02 on a 30×30 Gray–Scott kernel with SciPy BDF, four ranks, ten steps, three repeats. This reproduces library execution, not the INCA Spray-A performance paper.

name: 36_model_acquisition_cost
caption: Acquisition lower bound sums actual train/validation trial costs; it additionally excludes shared history generation, experiment duplication and postprocessing. Offline training is not free merely because ridge fitting is fast.

name: 37_profiling_overhead
caption: Three randomized on/off trials per action. Main performance claims use profiling off; this small calibration cannot resolve sub-percent overhead.

name: 38_oracle_margin_noise
caption: A median winner does not establish a statistically separated action. CV and margin are different statistics; this plot flags weak separation without fabricating an oracle confidence bound.

name: 39_species_normalization
caption: Every major action is checked against the same-repeat A0 endpoint. Exact zeros are displayed at 1e-17 to permit the logarithmic axis; raw values are retained. Species positivity and per-field scales are checked separately; normalization alone is insufficient.

name: 40_deployment
caption: Five independent trials per policy. Controller feature extraction, inference and action setup are actually timed and charged. Training/validation data only fit the frozen model before this campaign.

name: 41_controller_phase_profile
caption: Three profiled controller executions in each representative condition, with paired profiling-off trials and field gates. Feature extraction and inference are separately charged; rank phase sums include synchronization and are not additive critical-path estimates.

name: 42_independent_confirmation
caption: Preselected moving positive and uniform negative conditions, twenty new randomized trials per action. No model refit or test-margin tuning. Same checkpoint 40 μs and 160 μs continuation, four ranks, 256 cells; complete action and process costs.

name: 43_transport_consequence_model
caption: Training uses whole training conditions only. Geometry is observed after actual partitioning and is not a free deployed-controller input. Transport duration includes synchronization effects; this is not an identifiable network-time predictor.

name: 44_conservation_diagnosis
caption: Seven independent physical-accuracy pilots plus two matched fine-time/four-pressure-corrector controls, following a nonconvergent moving-condition energy budget. Point/line distinctions identify grid, pressure-correction and PIMPLE outer-coupling changes; these are diagnostics, not controller tuning or an exact conservation reference.

name: 45_mpi_consequence_model
caption: Two training conditions, one entirely held-out moving condition, three profiled repeats per action. Post-partition inputs are measured and not free online features. MPI-call durations do not identify pure network-transfer cost; independent physical sample size remains small.

name: 46_live_mesh_numerical_controls
caption: Each control uses the same observed post-migration physical checkpoint and fixed mesh ownership. Original timestep, finer global timestep and tighter ODE tolerance are compared with matching A0 controls. The original rejected trial remains in the dataset; thresholds are unchanged and these controls do not replace its timing. Exact-zero normalized errors are displayed at 1e-12 for the logarithmic axis.

name: 47_mapped_flux_audit
caption: Stored mass-flux divergence is compared with A0 on canonical cells, along with flux divergence reconstructed from equivalent cell rho/U. Cell-centre differences are retained in the source data. A symmetric-log axis is linear within 1e-8 of zero; no values are replaced. These observations localize discrepancies and do not by themselves prove a corrected migration algorithm.

name: 48_initial_coefficient_mass
caption: A separate diagnostic executable preallocates initial psi.oldTime before the first thermodynamic update; two steps at each of two global timesteps locate the mass offset. The original oracle/controller executable and dataset are unchanged. This initialization check does not establish long-time energy or flame convergence.

name: 49_flux_preservation_controls
caption: Separate controls preserve source flux on exact observed ownership maps or restore the exactly zero coupled copy from its existing nonzero periodic partner. Every delivered control passes the original full-field gate; original failed timings remain rejected. All values are positive and displayed without clipping; utility launch costs are retained. Axis-aligned stationary geometry only; the snapshot utility uses global face storage and is not a scalable general-purpose mapper.

name: 50_live_heldout_costs
caption: Three original trials in each of three held-out conditions. Ratio of summed condition medians includes preprocessing, decomposition, prefix, controller decisions, migration and every continuation. Conditional 95% intervals resample runs within those fixed conditions and do not estimate a population of flows. The hatched mesh ratio is descriptive only: its original numerical gate failed. No failed trial is removed or replaced by a repair control.

name: 51_full_history_initialization
caption: Two full moving-condition histories use the separate initialization-only executable: original 2 μs / one pressure corrector and 0.03125 μs / four pressure correctors. The mass offset is removed throughout; residual energy drift quantifies a distinct limitation. These differ in timestep and pressure coupling and are not a single-variable convergence sweep. Original frozen performance data are unchanged.
